title: Long-Term Residency 2026-2027
summary: Year-long residency with 24/7 studio access and lodging. Includes wood kiln firing (catenary arch or train kiln) available fall 2026 onward; artists must apply as a group under Artist Invites Artists program.
source_quote: INTERESTED IN FIRING A WOOD KILN AT RLCC? Beginning in the fall of 2026, any artist who is interested in firing a wood kiln (either the catenary arch, or train kiln) will need to apply with a group of artists under the "Artist Invites Artists" or "AIA" application portal
evidence_sentence: The residency info page states artists can fire wood kilns (catenary arch or train) starting fall 2026 by applying under the Artist Invites Artists program.
